generations.name: First generation (G60)
generations.notes: Launch. 81.2 kWh net / 84.3 kWh usable (BMW quotes 84.3) pack, up to 205 kW DC on eDrive40, xDrive40 and M60. MY2027 adds a native NACS port and new EPA ratings with no battery change (BMW blog/InsideEVs); M60 dropped for 2027. The LCI with Gen6 cells is expected about 2028 and would start a new generation. Touring is not sold in North America. Confidence: high (researched 2026-11-19, owner review pending). Sources: https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/BMW_5_Series_(G60) ; https://insideevs.com/news/802185/2027-bmw-i5-range-increase/ ; https://www.bmwblog.com/2026/04/07/2027-bmw-i5-facelift-rimac-batteries/
